probes.name: LTC7001 initial BST and gate response
probes.source_path: C:\pioneer\先进通用履带底盘工程\电力\稳压模块\仿真\源码\LTC7001_厂家模型初充与门极.net
probes.result_directory: C:\pioneer\先进通用履带底盘工程\电力\稳压模块\仿真\结果\LTC7001_厂家模型探针\原时序1s_完成

conditions.vcc: 0 V initially, 12 V at 1 us, held through 1.02 s
conditions.inp: 0 V until 0.999999 s; 3.3 V from 1.000000 s through 1.005999 s; then 0 V
conditions.gate_load: TGUP to external gate through 10 kohm; 32.1 nF linear Cgs and 1 Mohm gate-to-ground resistor
conditions.bst_load: 1 uF from BST to ground; TS fixed at 0 V
conditions.analysis: Transient to 1.02 s, max step 50 us, Normal solver, trap method, 27 C

limits: This is a component-level LTC7001 macro-model probe, not the complete board or high-side power stage.
The external MOSFET is represented only by a linear 32.1 nF gate capacitance and resistors; no nonlinear gate charge, parasitics, bus, or actual load is included.
The result does not establish physical precharge time, fault-energy handling, board behavior, or hardware acceptance.

probes.name: LTC7001 12 V loss and recovery
probes.source_path: C:\pioneer\先进通用履带底盘工程\电力\稳压模块\仿真\源码\LTC7001_厂家模型12V掉电恢复探针.net
probes.result_directory: C:\pioneer\先进通用履带底盘工程\电力\稳压模块\仿真\结果\LTC7001_厂家模型探针\12V掉电恢复

conditions.vcc: 0 V initially; 12 V from 1 us to 1.02 s; 0 V starting 1.020001 s through 1.080000 s; returns to 12 V at 1.080001 s and remains at 12 V through 2.12 s
conditions.inp: 0 V until 0.999999 s; rises to 3.3 V at 1.000000 s and remains at 3.3 V through 2.12 s, including the entire VCC outage and recovery; no new INP rising edge after VCC recovery
conditions.gate_load: TGUP to external gate through 10 kohm; 32.1 nF linear Cgs and 1 Mohm gate-to-ground resistor
conditions.bst_load: 1 uF from BST to ground; TS fixed at 0 V
conditions.analysis: Transient to 2.12 s, max step 50 us, Normal solver, trap method, 27 C; .save records VCC, gate, BST, INP, TGUP

probes.interpretation_boundary: INP is intentionally high throughout the power loss and recovery. The macro-model therefore reasserts gate once BST has recharged, without a new INP rising edge. This is not evidence that the board requires a fresh ARM event; the external latch/controller that must hold INP low until explicit re-arm is absent from this probe.
